title: E6 Dual-Ended Eyeshadow Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A dual-ended eyeshadow brush with both narrow and dense bristles ideal for applying, shading, and blending all shadow formulas.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: The small side of this brush features narrow bristles with a pointed shape to define and smoke out liners and shadows. The large side of the brush features short, dense bristles with a rounded shape for detailed placement and all-over shading.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Pair this brush with the Master Mattes® Eyeshadow Palette: The Neutrals for the perfect eyeshadow application.
-All MAKEUP BY MARIO brushes are cruelty-free and made with a custom blend of synthetic and vegan fibers and 100 percent FSC-certified birchwood handles.
-Mario’s dual-ended shadow and liner brush builds and blends shadows with ease.
-Use the fuller side of the brush to apply and layer shadows onto eyelids.
-Use the smaller side of the brush for more precise application and to smoke and define the lash line.
